title: 12 Times a Godly Man Goes First So Nobody Else Has To
caption:
12 times a godly man goes first, so nobody else has to.

The apology in the group chat. The hard conversation with his dad. The job nobody wants. Somebody has to go first in every one of these. It might as well be him.

Christ didn't wait for an invitation either. You did not choose me, but I chose you (John 15:16).

Going first isn't about being the loudest in the room. It's about being the one strong enough to move when everyone else is waiting.

#faith #scripture #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #service
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
